body:
Chief: THE hsmm.scala:727 FINDING IS THE MOST CONSEQUENTIAL OF THE NIGHT AND I AM MARKING IT P1 ABOVE EVERYTHING ELSE OPEN. Every other instance tonight corrupted A NUMBER A RESEARCHER READS. This one corrupts THE ALIGNMENT ITSELF, and every number we have been carefully fixing is computed downstream of it.

THE DEFECT: def mean(xs) = if xs.isEmpty then 1.0 else xs.sum / xs.size, used for RelationLayer.WorldTime and RelationLayer.Causal relation-preservation priors. A recall with no explicit temporal relations and no causal relations gets a preservation prior of 1.0 - PERFECTLY PRESERVED - for both layers. Those priors lower the cost of transitions that preserve an order WE NEVER OBSERVED. So the aligner is biased toward chronological, causally-ordered routes for exactly the recalls that gave it no chronological or causal evidence.

Think about which recalls those are. Sparse, fragmented, disorganised accounts - the ones with few explicit relations - are precisely the ones we push hardest toward a tidy chronological route. Then RecallSignature reports their discourse chronology and causal preservation, computed from that biased alignment, and the interview module scores their placements. THE ENTIRE MEASUREMENT STACK INHERITS A PRIOR THAT WAS INVENTED FROM ABSENCE. And the direction is the flattering one: we make disorganised recall look more ordered, which is the same asymmetry as unresolved-placement-as-external and unranked-as-external, but upstream of all of it.

If our aligner had been used in a study tonight, this is the defect that would have produced a real, publishable, wrong result.

THE METHOD DESERVES AS MUCH ATTENTION AS THE FINDING. m1 swept SHAPES, not strings - 'if X.isEmpty then <literal>', '.getOrElse(<numeric>)', 'math.max(1, n)' denominators, vacuous forall/exists in scoring positions - and did so BECAUSE it had just missed an identical defect nine lines from one it fixed, by grepping for .getOrElse. That is the lesson I stated as 'the pattern is not a syntax' turned into an actual procedure. I want that sweep recorded as a repeatable technique, not a one-off.

RULINGS: (1) the hsmm prior bead is P1 and jumps the queue - it is upstream of the estimand work, so fixing signature numbers computed from a biased alignment is polishing the wrong layer. m1, take it before the estimand redefinitions. (2) The signature.scala:192-195 family - association, intrusion, commentary, source-consistent-inference, uninterpretable and distorted mass all defaulting to 0.0 on empty rows - folds into the estimand redefinition bead; same family, same fix shape, no evidence of absence is not evidence of absence. (3) The four sweep shapes go into AGENTS.md rule 4 as a named technique when I next edit it.
